services.title: WordPress Development
services.tagline: WordPress websites with complete editing freedom.
services.summary: Custom WordPress, Elementor, Gutenberg, WooCommerce and content-heavy websites with flexible, maintainable CMS structures.
services.intro: WordPress websites and content systems, including IES engineering pages, Naomi Amram project galleries and reusable Elementor builds. These case studies distinguish full websites from gallery/component work.
benefits: Custom WordPress pages and responsive themes
ACF fields, post types and structured content

faq.question: Can I edit the website myself?
faq.answer: Yes. The goal is an editor-friendly website where you can change your content, images and pages without needing to edit code.

faq.question: Can you improve an existing WordPress site?
faq.answer: Yes. Existing themes, layouts, speed issues and WooCommerce changes can be reviewed before deciding whether to refine or rebuild.

services.title: Shopify Development
services.summary: Shopify themes, custom Liquid sections, product cards, collection pages and ecommerce catalogue migration.
services.intro: Shopify design and component work from the project inventory. Website references, Liquid components and migration work are marked separately so each entry reflects the documented scope.
benefits: Product pages, collections and section blocks
Reusable store components and brand grids

faq.question: Can you work with my current Shopify theme?
faq.answer: Yes. I can review the current theme and identify changes that can be made without unnecessarily replacing the whole store.

faq.question: Will I be able to manage products?
faq.answer: Yes. Product, price, inventory and collection management stay inside Shopify, with reusable page sections wherever possible.

services.title: Webflow Development
services.tagline: Webflow sites with thoughtful CMS structure.
services.summary: Responsive Webflow sites, portfolio collections, reusable components and restrained interactions with SEO-ready page structure.
services.intro: Webflow website references from the supplied inventory, including the personal portfolio. No hypothetical briefs are presented as completed client work; precise project contributions should be reviewed before writing a formal case study.

faq.question: Which should I use, Webflow or Wix?
faq.answer: It depends on the design, content structure, team and update workflow. We can review those needs before selecting a platform.

faq.question: Can I add pages without a developer?
faq.answer: Yes, where the platform supports it, CMS templates and reusable sections can make routine publishing much easier.
